text.tspan: The same bend, two different kink thresholds
solidcore #2785 · tests 13/14 compare a radius of curvature, a length, with size_xyz / size_t / 10000, a speed
A. the same Bézier, drawn once, over two parameter intervals
the same span carries 50× more parameter, so the average speed is 50× smaller:
a tolerance that is a fraction of the speed moves 50×; the radius does not move at all
C. the tolerance the check compares that radius with
at T = 1 the speed tolerance is 1.41e-4, above the radius: reported
at T = 50 it is 2.83e-6, below it: not reported
